JCHD: Promote, Protect, Provide Health
To improve quality of life and health outcomes by promoting, protecting,
and providing for the health of all Jefferson County residents.

Development of emergency plans, and coordinating emergency response agencies

Health First Indiana
Health First Jefferson County is part of a statewide initiative to ensure that every Hoosier has access to the core public health services that allow them to achieve their optimal health and wellbeing.
Health First Indiana is an initiative created by Senate Enrolled Act 4, legislation passed by the 2023 Indiana General Assembly that transforms public health. The legislation provides funding...
